text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer! Heehee! I'll always treasure it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'll never let it out of my sight! Even when I'm eating snacks or dinner!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: …Oh, speaking of snacks… I could really go for some carrot ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's get some on the way back! Heehee! Carrot ice creeeam! ♪
